messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: billing.metering.token_delta > 10% (30m) — first alert triggered 2024-10-18T08:12:25Z. See https://redwood.internal/alerts/4490012345 :rotating_light:

sanjay_oncall: I'm on-call, joining bridge now — creating Zoom/Bridge: https://zoom.redwood/4490012345

maya_ops: quick checks: stream consumer groups look healthy but apac-ingest has a spike in commit latency ~ 45s, backlog ~ 43k msgs. pushing logs to https://dash.redwood/streams/apac-ingest

eli_billing: seeing token_count vs reported usage diverge starting ~06:45 UTC — customers flagged for overages around 07:10. Flat delta ~+12% tokens compared to reconciled ledger.

kevin_engineering: preliminary: emitter service retried a subset of upstream requests (503s) and we see duplicate downstream emits. Likely double-count for some windows. Investigating dedupe keys.

maya_ops: running quick query:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM meter.events WHERE window>= '2024-10-18T06:30:00Z' AND source='apac-emitter' GROUP BY bin(15m)
```
returns an unexpected spike between 06:40-07:00 UTC.

eli_billing: customers already got overage flags. Can we stop further notifications and bulk-suppress until we confirm?

sanjay_oncall: @maya_ops please flip the suppression flag. @cs-ops prep a customer comms draft (internal) and hold on sending until we confirm impact.

maya_ops: flipping flag: `billing.pause_overage_notifications=true` -> true (applied). Confirmed: system will not send new overage emails. :white_check_mark:

cs-ops: drafting short note to affected accounts, will share here for review. Wants ETA on root cause and expected reconciliation window.

kevin_engineering: root cause candidate: emitter retry path didn't set idempotency keys for batched calls after a recent deploy (r2024-10-16). Repro locally. Rollback candidate in CI, planning hotfix.

zoe_product: how many customers affected (rough order)?

eli_billing: quick customer slice: ~42 customers saw a transient overage flag, 7 of them hit hard thresholds (>$100 immediate alert). We'll prepare list and PR to CS.

maya_ops: mitigation plan executed: 1) paused overage notifications 2) halted downstream aggregation job for 5m to avoid compounding counts 3) triggered consumer replay on a staging partition to validate dedupe logic.

sanjay_oncall: ETA on hotfix?

kevin_engineering: building patch to include idempotency header on retry, testing now. If tests pass, aiming for canary deploy in 18m.

eli_billing: for billing reconciliation, we should snapshot current counts and mark window as "investigation" to avoid automatic invoice generation. Can ops capture snapshot?

maya_ops: captured snapshot: `metering_snapshots/2024-10-18T08:14Z.json` uploaded to S3. Tagging it to the incident.

cs-ops: shared draft to #customer-ops (internal) with proposed language: short apology, note investigating, no immediate charges until reconciled. Waiting approval from legal/product.

zoe_product: approve comms once we know scope and reconciliation plan. Also want a postmortem on why the feature flag for idempotency wasn't gated.

kevin_engineering: canary deployed hotfix at 08:29 UTC to 5% traffic, monitoring token emission rate and duplicate keys. No regressions in 6m. Rolling to 25%.

maya_ops: downstream aggregator resumed at 08:38 UTC with dedupe enabled. Monitoring feed: no repeat spikes so far. Backfills paused until final reconcile.

eli_billing: turning on a reconciliation job to compute corrected token counts and prepare credit adjustments for affected accounts. Will post results here when ready.

cs-ops: legal has reviewed the comms. We will send notice to the 42 impacted customers at 09:05 UTC after recon confirmation.

sanjay_oncall: updating incident channel: severity = P2 (customer impact limited, mitigation in place). Owner: kevin_engineering. Scribing: cs-ops.

kevin_engineering: rolling out hotfix globally at 08:45 UTC. Monitoring.

maya_ops: consumer lag has drained to nominal levels (backlog -> 1.2k). No new duplicate keys observed.

eli_billing: reconciliation run initial pass: net delta -> corrected counts reduce billed tokens by ~10.8% for affected windows. Preparing credit entries and invoice suppression flags.

cs-ops: sent comms at 09:06 UTC. Customers acknowledged, some asked for estimates of credits. Linking ticket list: https://redwood.internal/cs/tickets?incident=4490012345

sanjay_oncall: nice work. Action items: 1) kevin - postmortem + root cause + deploy gating (idempotency test) 2) maya - replay/backfill plan and automation to detect duplicate emit patterns 3) eli - finalize credits and audit trail 4) cs-ops - close customer comms loop. Target: full postmortem by EOD.

kevin_engineering: ack, will attach PR and deploy timeline to the incident doc.

maya_ops: will run backfill in dry-run mode and share diff before applying.

eli_billing: will provide CSV of affected accounts + credit amounts by 11:30 UTC.

cs-ops: will follow up one-to-one with the 7 highest-impact customers.

incidents-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=P2, incident_owner=kevin_engineering, tags=[metering, billing, apac, duplicates]. More details: https://redwood.internal/incidents/4490012345

sanjay_oncall: closing live bridge. If any new alerts pop, re-open. Thanks team. :heart:
